duplication_audit.novel_axis: two fixed conditional residual quantiles whose central-interval midpoint supplies a robust point correction
duplication_audit.distinction: Prior P3 Huber/Ridge/GBDT heads optimize conditional location directly; uncertainty routers use component spread. No P3 lineage fits pinball-loss conditional residual quantiles and converts a sealed central interval to a point forecast.

rejected_axes.fixed_shapelet_dictionary: semantic duplicate of executed interval-convolution ROCKET and nearest-shape analog families
rejected_axes.expectile_half: exactly the conditional squared-loss mean and therefore a direct Ridge-location duplicate

features.row_features: 108 case statistics + station one-hot3 + lead one-hot6

model.target: rowwise target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.family: two fixed linear QuantileRegressor heads with HiGHS solver
model.point_functional: arithmetic midpoint of q25 and q75 residual predictions

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Koenker and Bassett, Regression Quantiles, Econometrica 46(1), 33-50 (1978)
